hash_54b90ebcf990b37d: Enjoy a high-level keycard, courtesy of the enemy. This is just the beginning. We're going to make them pay... Literally.
hash_54b90dbcf990b1ca: Update complete. I've granted you access to my old base. You'll find a device there that should help you out. Make them regret ever setting foot on Rebirth.
hash_54b90cbcf990b017: The updated device will now funnel enemy assets directly into your pocket. We're using their own resources against them.
hash_54b90bbcf990ae64: I cracked syphoning from contracts a long time ago, but this new protocol is a step up. We're not limited to cash anymore.
hash_54b90abcf990acb1: Everyone hacks contracts now. You can thank the tech shared when Vondel needed defending from hostile invaders... Sound familiar?
hash_54b909bcf990aafe: This isn't the first time I've shared tech with operatives. Even left scanners behind in Vondel to test potential recruits.
hash_54b908bcf990a94b: Nobody saw the Vondel attack coming. Lesson learned. I knew Rebirth couldn't last forever and had backups ready.
hash_54b907bcf990a798: Places like Rebirth, they draw conflict, like combat magnetism. It's cyclical, the fighting always rolls back around. History repeats.
hash_54b906bcf990a5e5: Impressed by your dedication. Fight after fight, you've earned these access boosts. Definite potential for something bigger.
hash_54b905bcf990a432: People try to preserve the past, but sometimes it's better to blow it all up and move on. Don't worry, I'd warn you before triggering the self-destruct sequence.
hash_54bc74bcf99396a6: Left my old base behind without a second thought. That's the advantage of being digital: Can be everywhere and nowhere.
hash_54bc75bcf9939859: Abandoning my base might seem like a loss, but with that device in your hands, I've got a knight among pawns. Chess, not checkers.
hash_54bc72bcf9939340: It's important to stay agile, always moving. Rebirth wasn't my only hideout. I'm not stranded with a laptop on coffee shop wifi.
hash_54bc73bcf99394f3: Will be checking in less frequently. Got other projects. Heading to clean up some unfinished business elsewhere.
hash_54bc78bcf9939d72: You're a good soldier, a worthy ally. Let's hope our interests stay aligned. Our paths may cross again in the future.
hash_5593c28de577c38e: Update requires restart. Just kidding. Enjoy your keycard.
hash_54bffcbcf996b395: Why trust the ghost in the machine? I can ensure you get a good keycard. Call it a sign of good faith.
hash_54bffbbcf996b1e2: Full disclosure: Every time you're scanned, I'm taking any useful field data collected. So, I appreciate your cooperation.
hash_54bff6bcf996a963: Listen, I can augment your access level. So put in maximum effort and get sweaty out there, okay?
hash_54bff5bcf996a7b0: Hacking these scanners was easy, but there's still a treasure trove of info to uncover. Just need some time... Stay tuned.
hash_54bff8bcf996acc9: I'm inside the system, boosting your access level, while you're out there cleaning up the island. We actually make a good team.
hash_54bff7bcf996ab16: Rebirth was serene before the invading high-tech home makeover project. Glad those airstrikes are tearing it back down.
hash_6277fed9bc7ff2bb: Mind asking demolitions to avoid the houses? There's a valuable keycard in it for you.
hash_54c001bcf996bc14: Had to leave the island when Konni invaded. There's still tech in my base that I can update remotely. I can trust you to field-test, right?

hash_59cd9f55722704b8: Tsuki Castle stood proudly on the serene island of Ashika. Such beautiful architecture hosting such fierce confrontation.
hash_59cda0557227066b: Vondel featured a unique combat scenario, with several historical buildings and waterways in which enemy forces could lurk.
hash_59cda1557227081e: A DNA bomb detonated in Urzikstan's Popov Power Plant spread a toxic substance with shocking results.
hash_59cda255722709d1: Up in the northern part of Verdansk, the Gora Dam offered a tactical view of its surrounding locations.
hash_59cda35572270b84: Residential Verdansk featured an iconic Ferris Wheel. An amusing attraction for snipers looking to show off their marksmanship.
hash_59cda45572270d37: Downtown was known as one of most lethal areas in Verdansk, with regular multi-squad, long-range battles being fought for rooftop control.
hash_59cda55572270eea: Rows of storage units held  a surplus of weapons and equipment south of the Verdansk Airport. A great location for operators in need of armament.
hash_59cda6557227109d: Verdansk's Military Base was the definition of risk-reward. The military gear would be ideal, if you didn't run into an enemy squad already holding it.
hash_59cd97557226f720: Answering a ringing phone in Verdansk revealed morse code messages. Operators discovered this was the key to unlocking the high-security Bunker 11.
hash_59cd98557226f8d3: Nighttime deployments in Verdansk led to unusual reports. Zombies? Ghosts? Hard to verify when those operators were never heard from again...
hash_59d79155722f4173: Tactics be damned, some squads took great pride in taunting their enemies while holding the multi-level Control Center on Rebirth Island.
hash_59d79055722f3fc0: Operators are more used to jumping out of planes than in them, but Caldera's Airfield offered a unique opportunity with its available aircraft.
hash_59d79355722f44d9: Fortune's Keep featured clusters of buildings in its Town area. A labyrinth of interiors perfect for evading enemy squads on the hunt.
hash_59d79255722f4326: In the middle of Al-Mazrah, Zarqwa Hydroelectric's complex layout enabled squads to move stealthily between the central areas of the region.
hash_59d79555722f483f: Most operators on Ashika Island stayed above the surface, but some took advantage of the installations below in underground waterways.
hash_59d79455722f468c: Vondel's Mall had an open-roof policy for drop-ins and stores of loot. Operators were free to shop 'til they were dropped.
hash_59d79755722f4ba5: High ground control often leads to victory, making Urzikstan's highrise building a hotly contested position.
hash_58f42055716e3c2b: You never forget your first win in the Gulag. And you never want to have to go back for a second.
hash_58f42155716e3dde: Atlas Superstore was Verdansk's top deployment location. An arena for the modern gladiator.
hash_58f42255716e3f91: When Shadow Company opened the roof to Verdansk's Stadium, operators wasted no time taking to the field.
hash_58f42355716e4144: Operation Know Your History broadcast an ominous warning from a Russian defector to operators as they ran for cover.
hash_58f42455716e42f7: An army of operators worked together to derail an armored train. Although successful, no one could survive the bombardment that followed.
hash_58f42555716e44aa: Combatants on Rebirth Island would take no prisoners, but operators kept coming back for more.
hash_58f42655716e465d: Volcanic eruption changed the face of Caldera's mountains forever, testing operators' ability to stand the heat.
hash_58f41755716e2ce0: The Mediterranean island of Fortune's Keep hosted a scenic multi-level Keep, prime for dropping into from above.
hash_58f41855716e2e93: Shadow Company's infamous strike on Konni Group opened up Al Mazrah. A permanent reminder of Operation Shadow Siege.
hash_1e7dce931898d581: You really know Verdansk inside and out.
hash_1e8eb99318a72505: It seems Verdansk has its secrets... Keep your eyes open.
